blocks.text: Natural sources include lightning, volcanoes, biological decay, forest fires, soil microorganisms and the oceans. NO is produced when N2 and O2 in the air react during lightning, and it is also produced by microorganisms using the nitrogen of the air.

blocks.caption: Natural sources of NOx
rows: N2 + O2 give 2NO in the hot discharge

blocks.prompt: Explain how a thunderstorm can add nitrate to the soil.
blocks.explanation: Lightning heats the air enough for nitrogen and oxygen to combine to NO, which is oxidised to NO2; this dissolves in rain as nitric and nitrous acids and reaches the soil as nitrate that plants can use.

items: Natural NOx: lightning (N2 + O2 to NO), volcanoes, decay, forest fires, soil microbes, oceans.
